title: MapleStory Classic Bowman Leveling Guide
author: Nia Meow
summary: A level 10-30 Bowman route covering DEX and STR allocation, Double Shot, bow and crossbow equipment tables, scrolling priorities, and Hunter or Crossbowman preparation.

sections.title: Core build
items: DEX is the primary stat with STR retained for equipment requirements.
Double Shot is the main shared first-job attack.

sections.title: Weapons and scrolling
items: Bow and crossbow choices do not lock the level 30 branch before advancement.
Use inexpensive early scrolling and replace gear at sensible breakpoints.

sections.title: Second job
items: Hunter continues with bows and Crossbowman uses crossbows.
Prepare the chosen weapon family before advancing.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Build Double Shot and shared first-job skills.
Choose efficient bow or crossbow upgrades.
Advance to Hunter or Crossbowman at level 30.
